name: AI Tools Capital

sources.title: Submit page — live form with Free $0 / Featured $49 / Premium $129 plans, field list, and submission guidelines

requirements: Free tier advertised with ~24h review; paid upgrades ($49 Featured badge+boost, $129 Premium editorial review) are optional
preparation: Tool name, website URL, category, and pricing model (Free/Freemium/Paid/Enterprise)
Square logo PNG/JPG/WEBP/SVG ≤3 MB — optional, can submit without it
A 10–500 character 'Why should we review it?' pitch; optional 'What makes it special?' (≤500 chars)
Optional: name of the founder who referred you (earns them a Contributor badge)
workflow: Optionally paste the tool URL into 'Auto-fill with AI' to prefill name/category/description, then review
Fill required fields, choose the Free plan unless paying for Featured/Premium
Submit — the tool joins that week's 'The Capital' leaderboard immediately; top-3 voted tools get a homepage podium spot each Monday
Use the emailed share kit to rally votes (one vote per person per tool; voting closes Sunday 23:59 UTC)
watchFor: Every submission auto-enters a weekly voting leaderboard — plan a small vote push if podium exposure matters
Paid tiers are upsells, not required for a listing
Site is small ('50+ hand-reviewed AI tools') despite the name — expect modest traffic
Affiliate disclosure present; editorial coverage tied to Premium tier
countsAsLive: The tool appears in the 'Recently submitted' section / its category page on aitoolscapital.com and on the week's leaderboard
unknowns: Whether the Free-tier listing page links dofollow
Exact review criteria beyond 'AI/ML focused' and 'publicly accessible'
Whether approved free listings are permanent
